title: Army Reserve fly water to Hurricane Harvey affected areas
description: In the wake of Hurricane Harvey the U.S. Army Reserve springs into action providing relief in Beaumont, Texas.  Soldiers from the 158th Aviation Regiment work with civilian volunteers to load CH-47 Chinook helicopters with palatalized cases of water and deliver the shipments to areas affected by flooding from Hurricane Harvey.
keywords: US Army Reserve, Conroe, Harvey, Beaumont, Hurricane Harvey, harvey2017, USAR, 158th Aviation Regiment
